India's LPG Subsidy at Risk if eKYC Not Done by June 30

The Indian government has set a deadline of June 30 for citizens to complete the electronic Know Your Customer (eKYC) process, which is required for LPG connections. Failure to do so may result in the suspension of gas subsidies for over 2.50 lakh consumers in Bhopal. The move aims to curb black marketing and ensure that only genuine customers receive benefits.
